paragraphs: Brooks Lee didn't need a pile of hits to leave his mark on Thursday, August 6, 2026. He came up with the one that mattered most.
The biggest swing came in the eighth, when Brooks Lee delivered a two-run go-ahead single. The play changed the score from 2-3 to 4-3 from his club's perspective. It came against Nate Pearson.
Minnesota Twins made it stand up in a 4-3 win over Kansas City Royals.
Brooks Lee hit 6 in the order and played 3B.
For Cal Poly followers, the night belonged to Brooks Lee and the Minnesota Twins. The box score may be brief, but the game context tells the better story.

title: Brooks Lee comes through late with go-ahead hit
